title: Third Rug from The Rug Market
text: Third Rug from The Rug Market. This is my third rug from The Rug Market, I do love these rugs!  So why only four stars? Right after I bought the rug the seller dropped the price by $8.00 and did not credit me. I literally purchased it and less than a minute later The Rug Market dropped the price, not a very good business tactic - thus the reason for only four stars.
